items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: Oh, this, uh, Tony Salazar, you know him, huh? Yeah. He used to take amity shell lessons from him.

ctx.x: Oh, he had a little boy that he was teaching him, a little boy on, uh. Roman Street. On Roman Street. Oh, he used to take interest in that little child. I could hear him telling that, uh, that, that little boy, don't blow bubbles. He said, blow from here, from your chest. From your chest. And then he'd be saying, hold your mouthpiece, take your, take your mouthpiece off your corner. Make him take it off and he'd hold it like that. Oh, yeah. Just try it alone, without the... Amity shell. Mama, tell him, you said…
Maybe we can find somebody else that could identify it. Yeah.
